name: CLA bot

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, reopened, synchronize, ready_for_review, labeled, unlabeled]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created, edited, deleted]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pull_request_number:
        description: Pull request number to recheck
        required: true
        type: number

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  statuses: write

concurrency:
  group: cla-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.issue.number || inputs.pull_request_number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  check:
    name: Check signatures
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
      (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' &&
       github.event.issue.pull_request &&
       github.event.comment.user.type != 'Bot')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      # Trusted base branch only. Never check out or execute pull-request code in
      # this privileged workflow.
      - name: Check out trusted CLA checker
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /.github/cla-config.json
            /CLA.md
            /tools/cla_check.py
            /tools/test_cla_check.py

      - name: Test checker
        run: python3 tools/test_cla_check.py

      - name: Record trusted CLA revision
        run: echo "CLA_DOCUMENT_REF=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Check CLA signatures
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          CLA_PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.issue.number || inputs.pull_request_number }}
          CLA_RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        run: python3 tools/cla_check.py
